vb_textbox.text: While it was not clear if there's a stable pattern or not, it seems that choosing the brightest gnomes quickly as well as quickly clicking the space bar as soon as the forest with the basket pops up will yield the best results. Don't get too hung up on the color of the gnomes, though, as it seems there's not a consistent pattern with the number of mushrooms that you will get, as it seems to change each round regardless of the color. However, it is very important to quickly press an option for a gnome as well as QUICKLY press the spacebar when the forest and basket come up, otherwise you'll be too slow to collect any mushrooms for that round. So, be quick and don't overthink it. I hope you have a great game and collect a bunch of mushrooms! Happy winning!
